Contemporary conflict and ‘reimagining’ museum practice: Imperial War Museum sets out new research aims.
Institution will focus on a broader chronology as it prepares for the second world war centenary.
The Research Strategy 2026–2031 identifies three priority areas: “reimagining museum practice”; “understanding our collections: meaning, memory, value”; and “conflict histories that matter now”.
